readings.section: Chapter 3 §§3.1–3.5: Platforms; The Basic Satellite Platform
§2.1 On the Ground, In the Air, In Space

changesZh: 补入地基/航空/航天观测与约束比较，区分UAV飞行器与UAS系统，保留高度不是质量保证的条件。
changesEn: Adds platform trade-offs and distinguishes UAV from UAS; altitude alone does not guarantee quality.

readings.section: Chapter 3 §3.5: Satellite Orbits (introduces COEs, focuses on inclination/altitude)
Chapter 7 §7.8: Land Observation Satellite Orbits (ellipse, nodes, perigee/apogee)

changesZh: 核对教材只引入六根数并重点讲倾角与高度；完整六根数仍按讲义。半长轴是地心长度，不能沿用教材把高度等同半长轴的简写。
changesEn: Checks the textbook scope; full COE definitions retain the lecture basis. Semi-major axis is a geocentric length, distinct from altitude.

zh: 同步轨道、太阳时与升降轨
en: Synchronous orbits, solar time and ascending/descending passes

readings.section: Chapter 7 §7.5: MODIS, Terra/Aqua daylight pass examples

changesZh: 补入Terra上午降轨/Aqua下午升轨示例；保留地球同步与静止区别、太阳同步不保证每日覆盖或全年太阳角相同。教材第193/195印刷页进动方向表述不一致，按东向交点进动理解。
changesEn: Adds Terra/Aqua daylight-pass counterexamples and retains geosynchronous/geostationary and local-time/revisit distinctions. The textbook’s precession-direction inconsistency is qualified.

zh: 开普勒模型、半长轴与周期
en: Kepler model, semi-major axis and period

readings.section: Chapter 3 §3.5: Satellite Orbits (altitude, orbital speed background)
Chapter 7 §7.8: idealized normal orbits and perturbations

changesZh: 教材作为椭圆与摄动背景阅读；三定律、周期公式和速度公式继续依据讲义/英文笔记，避免宣称教材本节完整推导。
changesEn: Uses the textbook for elliptical-orbit and perturbation background; the laws and formulas retain their lecture/English-notes derivation.

zh: 周期、重访、重复轨迹与覆盖
en: Period, revisit, repeat track and coverage
changesZh: 逐项核查轨道周期/重复轨迹/重访/可用观测表；CCRS §2.6与§2.2对重访的简写不一致，采用本站四项分开定义。
changesEn: Checks the four timing terms and qualifies CCRS’s inconsistent shorthand across §§2.2 and 2.6.

zh: 位置、姿态、观测角与立体
en: Position, attitude, viewing angles and stereo

readings.section: Chapter 4 §4.4: Digital Camera Designs; Linear Arrays
Chapter 8 §8.3: Geometry of the Radar Image

changesZh: 核查定轨/定姿与离天底/地面入射角的不同参考点；教材线阵多视角例证对应沿轨立体，未将多角度自动等同立体。
changesEn: Checks position/attitude and angle reference points; uses multi-view linear arrays as stereo examples without equating all multi-angle observations with stereo.

zh: 历史任务与传感器组合

readings.section: Chapter 7 §§7.3–7.4: Landsat Origins and Evolution; SPOT, Sentinel-2, CBERS, ASTER
Chapter 7 §7.5: Broad-Scale/Coarse Resolution Satellites; MODIS, VIIRS

changesZh: 对照载荷组合与长期记录；保留Landsat8 OLI/TIRS、MODIS离散多光谱归类；书中出版时状态与型号表不作为2026现状。
changesEn: Checks payload combinations and continuity; retains OLI/TIRS and MODIS multispectral classification. Publication-era status tables are not current 2026 specifications.

zh: 任务到平台与观测条件
en: From a task to platforms and observing conditions
changesZh: 核对任务优先而非像元最小优先，分清几何机会与可用数据、跨传感器时序与定标。
changesEn: Checks task-first choices, available opportunities versus usable data, and cross-sensor temporal/calibration constraints.

changesZh: 逐节增设来源页对应锚点，分开PDF文件页与书内印刷页；讲义与教材原图均可按图注追溯。
changesEn: Adds section-specific source links and separates PDF file pages from printed pages; original lecture/textbook figures are traceable through captions.

zh: 传感器、探测器、采样与量化
changesZh: 补入位置/时间采样与幅度量化的区别，核对探测、ADC与定标环节。
changesEn: Distinguishes spatial/temporal sampling from amplitude quantisation and checks detection, ADC and calibration.

zh: 画幅摄影、投影与数字相机
en: Frame photography, projection and digital cameras

readings.section: Chapter 4 §§4.2–4.4: aerial camera components, geometry and digital camera designs

changesZh: 补充滚动快门/多镜头合成例外，避免数字摄影必定单中心同时曝光；保留image/photograph历史与现代用法边界。
changesEn: Qualifies the single-centre/simultaneous-exposure ideal using rolling shutters and multi-head composites; retains historical versus modern image/photograph usage.

changesZh: 补充驻留时段与电子积分时长的严格区别；保留横轨线阵与沿轨运动、CCD不是扫描方式、探元交叉定标条件。
changesEn: Separates available dwell from electronic integration and retains scan directions, CCD/scan-method distinction and detector cross-calibration.

readings.section: Chapter 5 §5.2: IFOV and ground resolved distance
Chapter 10 §10.3: Instantaneous Field of View; Figure 10.4
§2.3 Spatial Resolution, Pixel Size, and Scale

changesZh: 补入离轴角IFOV不变但足迹放大拉长与扫描地面速度改变；检测/分辨、像元格网/原始足迹继续分开。
changesEn: Adds off-nadir footprint enlargement and nonuniform ground scan speed; retains detection/resolution and grid/footprint distinctions.

zh: 四类分辨率与光谱指标

readings.section: Chapter 5 §§5.2–5.4: dynamic range, SNR, spectral sensitivity/FWHM and digital data
§§2.3–2.6: spatial, spectral, radiometric and temporal resolution

changesZh: 补入中心波长、FWHM与采样间隔对照，教材把sampling interval/bandwidth并称时本页明确区分；不把位深等同有效灵敏度。
changesEn: Adds centre-wavelength/FWHM/sampling-interval comparison and qualifies the textbook’s interval/bandwidth shorthand; bit depth remains distinct from effective sensitivity.

changesZh: 核对真/假彩色属于显示映射，波段编号必须对应仪器；全色锐化不等于全波段新观测。
changesEn: Checks display mapping and instrument-specific band numbers; pan-sharpening is not a new observation in every band.

zh: DN、辐亮度、亮温与地表温度
en: DN, radiance, brightness and surface temperature

readings.section: Chapter 10 §10.3: Thermal Radiometry and reference calibration
Chapter 10 §§10.6–10.7: emissivity, thermal inertia and land surface temperature

changesZh: 新增定标链层次表与混合温度非线性，日夜热惯量解释；反演依据波段辐亮度而非必须测到光谱峰值，亮温不直接等于地温。
changesEn: Adds calibration-level comparison and nonlinear mixed-temperature/diurnal effects; retrieval uses band radiance rather than requiring peak-wavelength measurement.

readings.section: Chapter 8 §§8.1–8.2: active microwave and system components
Chapter 8 §§8.5–8.8: wavelength, penetration, polarization and backscatter interpretation

changesZh: 修正中文双程反射为双反射，与雷达往返传播分开；波长、极化、粗糙度、介电与几何联合解释，未照录C波段表排印错误。
changesEn: Corrects double-bounce wording and separates it from round-trip propagation; jointly interprets wavelength, polarisation, roughness, dielectric properties and geometry.

readings.section: Chapter 8 §§8.2–8.3: RAR/SAR, Doppler and radar geometry
Chapter 8 §8.4: Look Direction and Look Angle (angle labels require convention)

changesZh: 新增离天底/俯角/入射/局部入射四角度表与近远距定义；指出教材look/depression混用，保持公式角度条件。多视与滤波不替代定标。
changesEn: Adds four-angle and near/far-range definitions, qualifying look/depression shorthand and formula assumptions. Despeckling does not replace calibration.

readings.section: Chapter 8 §§8.3–8.4: range geometry, layover, foreshortening and radar shadow

changesZh: 核对脚/顶斜距顺序与缺观测信息；阴影不必由叠掩或收缩导致，几何校正不能补回未观测区域。
changesEn: Checks slant-range ordering and missing observations; shadow is not necessarily caused by layover/foreshortening and correction cannot restore unmeasured regions.

readings.section: §3.7 Advanced Radar Applications: stereo radar, interferometry and polarimetry

changesZh: 补入雷达立体视差与InSAR相位差、空间与时间基线区别；保留相干性、符号、解缠与LOS边界，修正教材干涉图描述为两复观测相位差。
changesEn: Distinguishes radargrammetric parallax from interferometric phase and spatial from temporal baseline; retains coherence, signs, unwrapping and LOS limits.

readings.section: Chapter 8 §8.10: Summary and Review Questions (optical–radar complementarity)
Chapter 10 §10.2: thermal sensitivity versus spatial detail

changesZh: 核对目标物理量、空间/光谱/时间/角度、有效数据与验证的任务链；光学和雷达互补，不以一项像元指标排名。
changesEn: Checks the task chain from target physics to scales, geometry, usable observations and validation; optical and radar complement one another.

readings.section: Chapter 5 §§5.2–5.6: electronic imagery, spectral/digital data and display
§§2.3–2.10: resolution, photography, scanning, thermal and distortion

changesZh: 为所有主节建立双语阅读入口、PDF与印刷页映射；更新插图来源政策为讲义和教材原图均明确标注。
changesEn: Creates bilingual reading entry points and PDF/printed-page mapping for every main section; original lecture and textbook figures both carry explicit provenance.
